description.name: Zenith Mode: Edge (Water, Fire, Lightning)
description.text: Increases [Fire/Lightning/Water Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Ninja abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Sprit Attack: Edge (Fire, Lightning, Water) after using two Ninja abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Ninjitsu+
description.text: 4/5/6 single hybrid attacks (1.20/1.25 or 570/592.5 each) if the user has Physical Blink 0/1/2, grants [Physical Blink 1] and [Physical Blink Stacking 2] to the user, capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Edge (Water/Fire/Lightning)
description.text: Three single hybrid attacks (0.58 or 218.3 each) followed by one single hybrid attack (3.05 or 18.33 each) that ignores DEF and RES, grants [Dualcast Ninja 1] and [Ninja Quick Cast 1] to user

description.name: Attach Water 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Fire 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
